'''2020 MPC Chris Menzel DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
